title: Infusion Pump Re-Flash Verification — Bench Status

fields.location: Clinical Engineering Bench Area, Level 2, Building A
fields.summary: Re-flashing of 22 infusion pumps from the offline 4.2.1 image has been completed. Each pump was tested with three rate entries (10, 25, and 50 units/hr) using a standard saline solution. All test infusions matched the entered rate within ±1.5% and did not trigger alarms at any point. The library hash (SHA-256) for each pump was verified against the known-good image in the offline repository. No pumps have been reconnected to ORRMC-PUMP01 or the device network. The 38 spares remain unflashed and isolated. A signed log for each pump will be maintained in the Engineering Control Room.

findings.item: Pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 status
findings.notes: Server remains isolated; no access granted

findings.item: Library version 4.2.1 on all re-flashed pumps
findings.notes: Verified via local console and hash check

findings.item: Test infusion accuracy at 10, 25, and 50 units/hr
findings.notes: All three rates matched within 1.5% of target

findings.item: No alarms triggered during test infusion
findings.notes: All pumps responded correctly to rate change

findings.item: Manual fallback mode active on all pumps
findings.notes: Confirmed via local interface

findings.item: Central telemetry network access
findings.notes: Network remains isolated per HCC directive

findings.item: Pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 access logs
findings.notes: Logs preserved but not accessed

findings.item: Pump firmware version
findings.notes: All units running v3.8.1, as per approved baseline

findings.item: Physical integrity of pump casing and tubing ports
findings.notes: No damage observed

findings.item: Signature log for each re-flashed pump
findings.notes: Log sheet completed and stored in Engineering Control Room

actionsTaken: Verified library hash (SHA-256) on all units
Performed three-rate test infusion on each pump
Signed log sheet for each pump with CE and nurse verification pending
Confirmed manual fallback mode is active
Notified CE and HCC of completion via radio at 17:32
recommendations: Reconnect pumps to network only after HCC approval and CE sign-off
Maintain signed log for every pump returned to service
Do not use any pump on 4.2.2 for high-alert drugs until full forensic rebuild of ORRMC-PUMP01
Preserve ORRMC-PUMP01 and ORRMC-VSB01 for forensic analysis
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_20260312-172501 (bench setup), IMG_20260312-172502 (test infusion), IMG_20260312-172503 (hash verification screen), IMG_20260312-172504 (signed log sheet)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the technical recovery of the pumps. The CE and CNO must now agree on the priority of pump return to service and the verification process. Watch for whether they prioritize high-alert units or standard care.
